PACKAGE.html.title: Nova.Avalonia.AIKit | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
PACKAGE.html.summary: Nova.Avalonia.AIKit Provider-agnostic Avalonia controls for polished AI-native applications: chat, streaming text, agent activity, approvals, tool calls, code review, retrieval, model selection, and usage dashboards. Install dotnet add package Nova.Avalonia.AIKit Register NovaTheme after the Avalonia base theme: <Application xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:nova="https://nova-ui.dev/aikit"> <Application.Styles> <FluentTheme /> <nova:NovaTheme /> </Application.Styles> </Application> Then use the controls directly with MVVM: <nova:PromptBar Text="{Binding PromptText}" ModelsSource="{Binding Models}" SelectedModel="{Binding SelectedModel}" PlaceholderText="Ask anything…" Command="{Binding SubmitPromptCommand}" /> PromptBar.Command receives the trimmed message. Use SubmitCommand for the complete submission snapshot. AIKit works on top of Fluent or Simple, supports light and dark themes, and has no dependency on a particular model provider or AI SDK. Documentation Documentation Source and samples

api/Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls.AgentAv.title: Class AgentAvatar | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
api/Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls.AgentAv.summary: Class AgentAvatar Namespace Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls Assembly Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.dll A living avatar for agent presence. The face is a lightweight 3D head: eyes sit on a sphere and follow a yaw/pitch/roll pose that wanders on layered noise, blinks on an organic schedule (sometimes twice), and masks expression changes behind a blink. Moods blend into each other; nothing snaps. Drawn on the render loop with no assets. api/Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls.Loading.summary: Enum LoadingIndicatorVariant Namespace Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls Assembly Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.dll Defines the animation style of a LoadingIndicator pixel grid. public enum LoadingIndicatorVariant Fields Dots = 1 Round pixels pulsing outward from the center of the grid. Drive = 0 Square pixels forming a chevron wavefront that drives to the right. Orbit = 2 A bright square with a fading trail sweeping clockwise around a dimmed center. Scan = 3 A horizontal band scanning down the grid with a soft trailing row. Signal = 4 Three bottom-up columns rising and falling like a compact activity meter. Spark = 5 Diamond pixels twinkling independently in a deterministic constellation. [Obsolete("Use Drive instead.")] Wave = 0 Square pixels forming a chevron wavefront that drives to the right. Use Drive. This name remains as a compatibility alias.

api/Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls.html.title: Namespace Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
api/Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls.html.summary: Namespace Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls Classes ActivityHeatmap A calendar heatmap: one column per week, one row per weekday, each cell tinted by activity intensity. Values run oldest first, top to bottom within each column. Cells grow to fill the given width, and hovering a cell shows its date and activity. AgentAvatar A living avatar for agent presence. The face is a lightweight 3D head: eyes sit on a sphere and follow a yaw/pitch/roll pose that wanders on layered noise, blinks on an organic schedule (sometimes twice), and masks expression changes behind a blink. Moods blend into each other; nothing snaps. Drawn on the render loop with no assets. AgentLink A delegation edge between two stable Id values. AgentNode One agent in a MultiAgentGraph. AgentTaskDetail A label and value pair shown in the expanded part of an AgentTaskRow. AgentTaskRow A pill-shaped card that tracks one live agent task: a lifecycle-specific status icon, title, meta text, a status badge and an expandable list of AgentTaskDetail rows. AgentTimeline A vertical session history: timestamped entries with kind-colored dots on a connector line, for messages, tool calls, checkpoints, and errors. Observable sources keep the connector correct as entries stream in. ApprovalAnswerEventArgs Event arguments for AnswerSubmitted. ApprovalCard A human-in-the-loop card that walks through one or more ApprovalQuestions before an agent acts: pick an option or type a custom answer, submit, and step through the questions with the progress footer. Raises Completed once every question is answered and Dismissed when closed. ApprovalOption A stable value and user-facing label offered by an ApprovalQuestion. ApprovalQuestion A question presented by an ApprovalCard. AttachmentTile A file attached to a prompt: a colored type badge, the file name, a detail line and a remove button, with a progress strip along the bottom while uploading. ChatComposer A chat input field with a send button. Enter or the button raises Submitted, executes Command with the message text, and can execute SubmitCommand with the structured submission payload. ChatMessage A message shown in a ChatMessageList. Messages are display snapshots: replace the item (or reassign the collection) to update one. ChatMessageList A scrolling chat transcript of ChatMessage items: user messages as right-aligned bubbles, assistant replies full width with a meta line. Scrolls to the newest message automatically while the viewport remains pinned to the end. ChatMessageSubmittedEventArgs Event arguments for Submitted. CitationChip A numbered inline citation. Clicking opens a flyout with the source title, domain, and snippet plus a link that opens the source in the browser. CodeBlock An agent written code card: a bar with the file name, language and a copy action over numbered, token colored lines. Stream lines by appending CodeLines; include a Caret token to show the writing position. CodeDiffView A unified code diff card: a file bar with change stats over gutter numbered lines, where additions tint green and removals tint red with +/− markers. CodeFileEventArgs Event arguments for FileSelected. CodeFileItem A file or folder display snapshot in a CodeFileTree. CodeFileTree A compact list of files the agent touched: indented rows with folder and file icons, change counts, and a status dot. Selecting a file raises FileSelected. CodeLine A numbered line in a CodeBlock. CodeToken A colored fragment of a CodeLine. CompanyRecord A row shown in a RecordsTable. Selection is observable; the other properties are display snapshots set at creation. ConfidenceMeter A compact three bar meter that visualizes a ConfidenceLevel: green for high, orange for medium and low, muted when there is no signal. ContextCard A retrieved knowledge chunk: a titled card with an excerpt, a meta label such as the character count, and a source pill with a colored file type badge. Set SourceUri to open the source in the browser when clicked. ContextUsageMeter A ring gauge for context window consumption. Shows the used share as a sweep with the percentage in the center and a token summary underneath, shifting to warning and critical colors as the window fills. DiffLine A line in a CodeDiffView. DiffTable A titled three column table that visualizes AI proposed edits: removed rows are tinted red with struck through values, added rows are tinted green. DiffTableRow A row shown in a DiffTable. EffortSelectedEventArgs Event arguments for EffortSelected. FeedbackBar A response action bar: copy, regenerate, and thumbs. A thumb down opens a comment flyout before submitting; after any submission the bar thanks the user. FeedbackEventArgs Carries the submitted FeedbackKind and optional comment. FilterTable A task table with status filter chips: selecting a chip shows only matching rows. Chips are generated from the distinct Status values with live counts, plus a leading "All" chip. FilterTableItem A row shown in a FilterTable. Visibility is animated when filtering. FilterTableStatus An immutable status shared by FilterTableItems and shown as a filter chip. Statuses with the same name and color are equal, so separately created instances filter together. To change a row's status, assign a new instance to Status. FineTuneCard A design inspector card the agent can drive: a layout switcher, scrubbing numeric fields for size, radius and opacity, and a type dropdown row. While IsAdjusting is true the header shows a shimmering "Adjust" indicator. FollowUpList A list of suggested follow-up questions shown under a streamed answer. Selecting an item raises FollowUpSelected and executes Command. FollowUpSelectedEventArgs Event arguments for FollowUpSelected. InlineSuggestionBox A text input with ghost text completion: the pending suggestion renders dimmed after the caret, Tab accepts it, Escape dismisses it. Insight One page of an InsightCards carousel. InsightCards A paged carousel of Insights: a header with count and pager arrows over the current insight's narrative, headline stats and trend chart. InsightSeries A line drawn by the insight chart. InsightStat A headline stat inside an Insight. LoadingIndicator A compact loading state composed of an animated pixel grid, a shimmering label and the elapsed time. ModelEffortOption A provider-facing reasoning-effort value and its user-facing label. ModelOption A model choice shown by a ModelPicker. ModelPicker A standalone model dropdown: the trigger shows the current model, the popup lists options with descriptions, metadata, and highlight badges. ModelSelectedEventArgs Carries the chosen ModelOption. MultiAgentGraph A small network of agents: nodes laid out at relative positions, delegation edges between them, pulses traveling along active edges, and a breathing ring on running nodes. Drawn on the render loop; the loop only runs while something is active. NovaMotion Provides the inherited motion policy used by Nova control templates. Applications normally set IsEnabledProperty through the NovaAnimationsEnabled resource. OperationFailedEventArgs Reports a recoverable platform operation failure from a control. PromptBar A message composer with slash commands, attachable sources, a model picker and a dictation toggle. Typing "/" filters CommandsSource and "@" or the attach button lists SourcesSource in a popup above the bar. PromptCommand A slash command offered by a PromptBar. PromptSource An attachable source offered by a PromptBar. PromptSourceEventArgs Event arguments for SourceSelected. PromptSubmittedEventArgs Event arguments for Submitted. PropertyFieldChip An inspector field: a drag label that scrubs the value horizontally, a numeric text box, and an optional suffix. Used by FineTuneCard. RecommendationAcceptedEventArgs Immutable accepted-recommendation data for orchestration correlation. RecommendationCard An agent suggestion card: title, description with inline code chips, a confidence meter, an expandable list of alternatives and Accept action. Wrap identifiers in the description in backticks to render them as accent chips. RecommendationOption An alternative suggestion listed by a RecommendationCard. RecommendationOptionEventArgs Event arguments for AlternativeSelected. RecordTag A colored category tag shown in a RecordsTable cell. RecordsTable A CRM style grid of CompanyRecord rows: checkbox selection, letter avatars, colored category tags, relationship strength dots, links and an optional calculation footer. ResponseActionEventArgs Immutable response identity for copy and regenerate actions. SearchItemEventArgs Event arguments for ItemSelected. SearchPanel A command search card: a search field over a result list that filters live while typing, with an empty state when nothing matches. Selecting a result raises ItemSelected. SelectionAction An action offered by a SelectionToolbar. SelectionActionEventArgs Event arguments for ActionInvoked. SelectionToolbar A floating pill toolbar for a highlighted passage: a free form edit prompt plus quick actions. Raises Submitted for typed edits and ActionInvoked for action buttons. SidebarNav A workspace sidebar: switcher header, quick search, an accent action row and labeled navigation sections. Clicking an item makes it current and raises ItemSelected. SidebarNavItem A navigation entry in a SidebarNav. SidebarNavItemEventArgs Event arguments for ItemSelected. SidebarNavSection A labeled group of SidebarNavItems in a SidebarNav. SourceChip A compact inline citation pill with an optional icon and monospaced label. Clicking it opens an absolute HTTP or HTTPS Avalonia.Controls.HyperlinkButton.NavigateUri in the default browser; relative and non-web addresses are ignored. Designed to sit inside a StreamingTextBlock but usable anywhere. StatTile A compact labeled statistic: a quiet caption above a prominent value, on a field surface. Compose several in a grid for an overview dashboard. StreamingTextBlock A text block that reveals appended words with a soft fade, the way chat assistants stream responses. Call AppendText(string) with each new chunk and FlushStreamedText() when the stream ends. Bind StreamedText when the upstream API only exposes growing snapshots. Inline content such as a SourceChip can be added with AppendInline(Control). ThinkingNote A free-form activity note shown as muted prose in a ThinkingTrace. ThinkingQuery A search query shown with a magnifier icon in a ThinkingTrace. ThinkingSource A retrieved source shown with a colored globe badge in a ThinkingTrace. ThinkingStep A completed work step shown with a check mark in a ThinkingTrace. ThinkingToolCall A tool invocation shown as verb + target in a ThinkingTrace. ThinkingTrace An expandable activity trace for agent work: a sparkle header that shimmers while thinking and collapses to a summary when done, above a timeline of steps, notes, sources or tool calls. TimelineEntry One event in an AgentTimeline. ToolCall A tool invocation shown as a row in a ToolCallList. Rows are display snapshots: replace the item (or reassign the collection) to update one. ToolCallIcons Maps a ToolCallKind to its icon geometry. ToolCallList A collapsible list of ToolCall rows: each row shows an icon, a label and a compact ToolChip, and expands to reveal its output lines. ToolCallOutput A single output line of a ToolCall. ToolChip A compact chip that shows a tool call detail such as a file name, command or note. Used inside ToolCallList rows and reusable on its own. VoiceWaveform Animated dictation level bars. While active the bars dance with a center-weighted envelope scaled by Level; idle they settle into a flat dotted line. Drawn on the render loop. Enums AgentAvatarShape The body silhouette of an AgentAvatar. AgentExpression A facial expression preset for an AgentAvatar. Auto derives the face from the current Mood; every other value pins the face while the mood keeps driving body motion and props. AgentMood The mood of an AgentAvatar. AgentNodeStatus The state of a MultiAgentGraph node. AgentTaskStatus The state of an AgentTaskRow. AttachmentStatus The lifecycle state of an AttachmentTile. ChatMessageStatus The delivery state represented by a ChatMessage snapshot. ChatRole The author of a ChatMessage. CodeFileStatus Change status of a CodeFileItem. CodeTokenKind The color role of a CodeToken. ConfidenceLevel Confidence shown by a ConfidenceMeter. DiffKind How a DiffTableRow is affected by the proposed edit. DiffLineKind How a DiffLine changed. FeedbackKind The direction of submitted feedback. FineTuneLayout Layout options offered by a FineTuneCard. LoadingIndicatorVariant Defines the animation style of a LoadingIndicator pixel grid. RecordStrength Relationship strength of a CompanyRecord. ResponseActionKind A non-feedback action requested for a response. TimelineEntryKind The category of an AgentTimeline entry. ToolCallKind The icon shown next to a ToolCall. ToolCallStatus The execution state represented by a ToolCall snapshot. ToolOutputKind The visual style of a ToolCallOutput line. TrendDirection Direction of an InsightStat value.

docs/controls/agents.html.title: Agent Controls | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/agents.html.summary: Agent Controls AIKit includes four levels of agent visualization: identity, a single task, chronological session history, and a graph of collaborating agents. Identity and task state <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12"> <nova:AgentAvatar Width="72" Height="72" Mood="Working" Expression="Neutral" BodyShape="Squircle" /> <nova:AgentTaskRow Title="Verify vendor records" Meta="12 suppliers" ProgressText="8" Status="Running" ItemsSource="{Binding TaskDetails}" /> </StackPanel> AgentAvatar can track the pointer and animate mood and expression changes. AgentTaskRow covers pending, running, completed, failed, and cancelled states, with an expandable detail source. Session timeline <nova:AgentTimeline Header="Refactor session" ItemsSource="{Binding Timeline}" /> Supply TimelineEntry items categorized by TimelineEntryKind. The timeline highlights the last entry and constrains long sessions with ItemsMaxHeight. Multi-agent graph <nova:MultiAgentGraph NodesSource="{Binding Agents}" LinksSource="{Binding Delegations}" IsAnimationEnabled="True" /> Use AgentNode and AgentLink objects with stable identities. Running nodes and active links can pulse, while completed, failed, and cancelled states use semantic status colors. Set AccessibleName to describe the graph's purpose. Relevant API AgentAvatar AgentTaskRow AgentTimeline MultiAgentGraph

docs/controls/approval-and-feedback.html.title: Approval and Feedback | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/approval-and-feedback.html.summary: Approval and Feedback ApprovalCard pauses an agent workflow for one or more explicit decisions. FeedbackBar captures response actions and evaluation after an answer is shown. Ask for approval <nova:ApprovalCard ItemsSource="{Binding Questions}" DraftAnswer="{Binding DraftAnswer}" SelectedOptionId="{Binding SelectedOptionId}" AnswerCommand="{Binding SubmitApprovalCommand}" DismissCommand="{Binding DismissApprovalCommand}" /> Each ApprovalQuestion can provide predefined ApprovalOption values, a risk label, and optional custom-answer support. The card handles question navigation and exposes CurrentIndex, ProgressText, CanGoNext, CanGoPrevious, and CanSubmit for state-aware templates. Selecting an option by SelectedOptionId also updates DraftAnswer to its label. Clearing the ID clears the selected answer and disables submission until a new answer is supplied. A changed draft updates the selected option to match, or becomes a custom answer when allowed. Submissions reject unknown option IDs and reject custom answers when AllowCustomAnswer="False"; structured submissions always use the selected option's ID and label together. For a closed approval such as publishing a change, set AllowCustomAnswer="False" and authorize only explicit structured option IDs in the host. Keep custom answers, unknown IDs, and dismissal on the hold path. The Hermes sample keeps the structured answer through its approval gate and applies this policy. Use AnswerSubmitted, Completed, Dismissed, and ResetRequested routed events when code-behind integration is more convenient. Set CanDismiss="False" for a required decision. Capture response feedback <nova:FeedbackBar ResponseId="{Binding ResponseId}" TurnId="{Binding TurnId}" Revision="{Binding Revision}" FeedbackCommand="{Binding SubmitFeedbackCommand}" ResponseActionCommand="{Binding ResponseActionCommand}" /> The feedback snapshot carries the stable response ID, optional turn ID, and revision so a delayed user action cannot be confused with a newer response. Thumb-down feedback can include a comment. Copy and regenerate have both specific events and a unified ResponseActionRequested event. Changing the response ID, turn ID, or revision closes and discards a pending comment and resets the submitted state. A comment must be started again for the new response. Reset() also cancels any pending comment. Relevant API ApprovalCard ApprovalQuestion ApprovalOption FeedbackBar FeedbackEventArgs

docs/controls/code-review.html.title: Code Review Controls | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/code-review.html.summary: Code Review Controls Use CodeBlock for tokenized source, CodeDiffView for unified changes, and CodeFileTree for a navigable summary of affected files. Show source code <nova:CodeBlock FileName="AgentService.cs" Language="csharp" ItemsSource="{Binding CodeLines}" CopiedCommand="{Binding CodeCopiedCommand}" /> CodeBlock accepts CodeLine items containing CodeToken values. This keeps tokenization provider-agnostic and lets the host stream line-by-line results. Copy success and failure are available as events and commands. Display a diff <nova:CodeDiffView FileName="AgentService.cs" ItemsSource="{Binding DiffLines}" LinesMaxHeight="420" /> Supply DiffLine items and classify them with DiffLineKind. The control renders gutters, line numbers, add/delete markers, and aggregate change labels. Navigate changed files <nova:CodeFileTree Header="Files changed" ItemsSource="{Binding Files}" FileSelectedCommand="{Binding OpenFileCommand}" /> CodeFileItem captures the path, status, and change counts. Handle FileSelected or bind FileSelectedCommand to synchronize the tree with a code or diff view. Relevant API CodeBlock CodeDiffView CodeFileTree CodeLine DiffLine

docs/controls/context-and-citations.html.title: Context and Citations | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/context-and-citations.html.summary: Context and Citations These controls make grounding visible. Use context cards before or during a run, source and citation chips inside an answer, and the usage meter to show remaining model context. Retrieved context <nova:ContextCard Title="Refund policy" Excerpt="Refunds are available within 30 days…" Meta="Updated 2 days ago" SourceLabel="Policy" SourceName="handbook.md" SourceUri="https://example.com/handbook" /> ContextCard separates the retrieved excerpt from its source metadata and supports custom source foreground and background brushes. Inline sources <WrapPanel> <TextBlock Text="Pistachio recovered in Q2 " /> <nova:CitationChip Number="1" Title="Quarterly sales report" Domain="reports.example.com" Snippet="Pistachio closed Q2 at +1.15%." NavigateUri="https://example.com/q2" /> <nova:SourceChip Text="Sales report" NavigateUri="https://example.com/q2" /> </WrapPanel> CitationChip opens a source preview and then navigates to NavigateUri. Handle SourceOpened and NavigationFailed, or bind their commands, for telemetry and error reporting. SourceChip is a lighter hyperlink label for a source already explained by surrounding content. Context-window usage <nova:ContextUsageMeter Capacity="200000" UsedTokens="{Binding UsedTokens}" Label="Research run" WarningThreshold="0.75" CriticalThreshold="0.9" /> The meter computes its percentage, label, and sweep angle. Thresholds change semantic color before the context limit is reached. Relevant API ContextCard CitationChip SourceChip ContextUsageMeter

docs/controls/conversation.html.title: Conversation Controls | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/conversation.html.summary: Conversation Controls Use ChatMessageList and ChatComposer for a compact chat surface, then add StreamingTextBlock and FollowUpList when the response arrives incrementally or suggests a next turn. Display and submit messages <Grid RowDefinitions="*,Auto" RowSpacing="8"> <nova:ChatMessageList ItemsSource="{Binding Messages}" AutoScrollToEnd="True" /> <nova:ChatComposer Grid.Row="1" Text="{Binding Draft}" PlaceholderText="Ask anything…" Command="{Binding SendMessageCommand}" /> </Grid> ChatMessageList.ItemsSource commonly contains ChatMessage records. AutoScrollToEnd follows new content only while the reader remains near the end; scrolling upward suspends automatic movement. Supply ItemTemplate when the transcript requires a custom message presentation. ChatComposer.Command receives the submitted text. SubmitCommand and the Submitted event receive a richer event snapshot. Set ClearOnSubmit="False" when the host should retain the draft. Submission clears the input before notifying handlers so a handler can supply a replacement draft. If an event handler or command throws synchronously and the input is still empty, the original draft is restored and the exception is propagated. Asynchronous send failures remain the host's responsibility. Stream an answer <nova:StreamingTextBlock StreamedText="{Binding CurrentAnswer}" RevealDuration="0:0:0.42" TextWrapping="Wrap" /> Use the bound property when the provider exposes growing snapshots. Replacing or shortening the string resets its inline state. Growing a string for every token copies the accumulated response, so prefer batched AppendText calls for long streams: // Run control updates on the Avalonia UI thread. answer.ResetStream(); answer.AppendText("First chunk "); answer.AppendText("and the next chunk."); answer.FlushStreamedText(); AppendText reveals new content immediately and debounces the public text snapshot. Call FlushStreamedText when the stream finishes, including cancellation when the partial response should be retained. Call ResetStream before displaying a new response: it clears text, citations, animations, and the pending snapshot timer even when the previous public snapshot is still empty, and preserves the binding. Cancel the previous producer and reject late chunks from an obsolete turn before resetting. Set IsAnimationEnabled="False" for immediate updates without fades. AppendText, AppendInline, FlushStreamedText, and ResetStream must run on the UI thread. Calls from another thread throw before changing stream state; dispatch background producer updates through Dispatcher.UIThread. Offer follow-ups <nova:FollowUpList Header="Try asking" ItemsSource="{Binding FollowUps}" Command="{Binding ChooseFollowUpCommand}" /> FollowUpList raises FollowUpSelected and supports Command or FollowUpCommand. Use ItemsMaxHeight to constrain a long generated list. Relevant API ChatMessageList ChatComposer StreamingTextBlock FollowUpList ChatMessage

docs/controls/data-and-insights.html.title: Data and Insights | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/data-and-insights.html.summary: Data and Insights These controls turn structured model output into reviewable application UI instead of a block of prose. Review structured changes <StackPanel Spacing="12"> <nova:DiffTable Header="Proposed changes" ItemsSource="{Binding Changes}" /> <nova:RecordsTable ItemsSource="{Binding Records}" /> <nova:FilterTable ItemsSource="{Binding FilteredWork}" SelectedStatus="{Binding SelectedStatus}" /> </StackPanel> DiffTableRow classifies old and new values with DiffKind. CompanyRecord supports selection, tags, and relationship metadata. FilterTableItem and FilterTableStatus provide live status filtering; observable sources update the view while attached. FilterTable.FilteredItems exposes the matching rows in source order. The built-in list virtualizes this projection, removing excluded rows immediately so sparse filters remain efficient on large sources. Chip counts still reflect the full source, and status changes update matching rows incrementally. Search and navigation <Grid ColumnDefinitions="240,*"> <nova:SidebarNav ItemsSource="{Binding Sections}" SearchText="{Binding NavigationFilter}" ItemSelectedCommand="{Binding NavigateCommand}" /> <nova:SearchPanel Grid.Column="1" ItemsSource="{Binding SearchCorpus}" SearchText="{Binding Query}" ItemSelectedCommand="{Binding OpenResultCommand}" /> </Grid> SearchPanel exposes FilteredItems and IsEmpty, limits results with MaxResultCount, and provides event or command activation. SidebarNav groups SidebarNavItem objects into sections and includes workspace and new-item actions. Show generated insights <StackPanel Spacing="12"> <nova:InsightCards Header="Highlights" ItemsSource="{Binding Insights}" /> <UniformGrid Columns="2"> <nova:StatTile Label="Sessions" Value="178" /> <nova:StatTile Label="Tokens" Value="71.5M" /> </UniformGrid> <nova:ActivityHeatmap Values="{Binding DailyUsage}" AccessibleName="Daily agent activity" /> </StackPanel> InsightCards pages through Insight objects and their statistics and trend series. ActivityHeatmap uses a date-aligned values source, configurable cell sizing, and an accessible summary format. Relevant API DiffTable RecordsTable FilterTable SearchPanel SidebarNav InsightCards StatTile ActivityHeatmap

docs/controls/fine-tuning.html.title: Fine-tuning Controls | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/fine-tuning.html.summary: Fine-tuning Controls Use SelectionToolbar for text-oriented AI actions and FineTuneCard with PropertyFieldChip for compact visual or structured adjustments. Act on a selection <nova:SelectionToolbar ActionsSource="{Binding SelectionActions}" Text="{Binding Instruction}" ActionCommand="{Binding RunSelectionActionCommand}" SubmitCommand="{Binding SubmitInstructionCommand}" /> SelectionAction entries describe actions such as rewrite, summarize, or explain. ActionInvoked reports the chosen action. The optional text field uses the familiar CanSend and ClearOnSubmit submission contract. Adjust properties <nova:FineTuneCard Title="Tune selected element" Layout="Row" ElementWidth="{Binding ElementWidth}" ElementHeight="{Binding ElementHeight}" ElementRadius="{Binding CornerRadius}" ElementOpacity="{Binding Opacity}" /> FineTuneCard provides width, height, radius, and opacity values plus an IsAdjusting state. PropertyFieldChip is the lower-level numeric primitive when the host needs a custom set of properties: <nova:PropertyFieldChip Label="Temperature" Minimum="0" Maximum="2" Value="{Binding Temperature}" Suffix="×" /> Relevant API SelectionToolbar SelectionAction FineTuneCard PropertyFieldChip

docs/controls/index.html.title: Control Guides | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/index.html.summary: Control Guides AIKit controls are designed to be composed. These guides group them by workflow while the API reference documents each public member. Guide Controls Conversation ChatMessageList, ChatComposer, StreamingTextBlock, FollowUpList Prompt bar PromptBar, PromptCommand, PromptSource Thinking and loading ThinkingTrace, LoadingIndicator, thinking item types Approval and feedback ApprovalCard, ApprovalQuestion, FeedbackBar Tool calls ToolCallList, ToolChip, ToolCall, ToolCallOutput Agents AgentAvatar, AgentTaskRow, AgentTimeline, MultiAgentGraph Code review CodeBlock, CodeDiffView, CodeFileTree Context and citations ContextCard, ContextUsageMeter, CitationChip, SourceChip Models and input ModelPicker, InlineSuggestionBox, VoiceWaveform, AttachmentTile Recommendations RecommendationCard, ConfidenceMeter Data and insights Tables, search, insights, statistics, heatmaps, and navigation Fine tuning FineTuneCard, PropertyFieldChip, SelectionToolbar Common integration pattern Bind the control's values or ItemsSource to host-owned state. Update that state as provider or agent events arrive. Handle routed events or bind commands for user intent. Send the intent to your application layer; AIKit does not contact a provider itself. Most collection controls observe INotifyCollectionChanged, so an ObservableCollection<T> is the natural choice for live transcripts, tools, tasks, and timeline events.

docs/controls/models-and-input.html.title: Models and Input | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/models-and-input.html.summary: Models and Input AIKit provides focused input controls that can be used independently of PromptBar. Select a model <nova:ModelPicker ItemsSource="{Binding Models}" SelectedModel="{Binding SelectedModel}" ModelSelectedCommand="{Binding RouteModelCommand}" /> Use ModelOption entries for stable provider-facing IDs, descriptions, badges, context sizes, and supported ModelEffortOption values. SelectedModel and IsDropDownOpen bind two-way by default. Offer inline completion <nova:InlineSuggestionBox Text="{Binding Draft}" SuggestionText="{Binding Completion}" PlaceholderText="Ask Nova anything" AcceptSuggestionCommand="{Binding AcceptCompletionCommand}" /> Tab accepts a compatible suggestion and Escape dismisses it. Acceptance is blocked while text is selected or the caret is not at the end, preventing an unexpected edit. Visualize voice input <nova:VoiceWaveform IsActive="{Binding IsListening}" Level="{Binding InputLevel}" BarWidth="3" BarSpacing="3" /> Level is normalized from 0 to 1. The host owns audio capture and permissions; this control only renders the input state. Present attachments <nova:AttachmentTile FileName="q2-sales.csv" Detail="Uploading 42%" TypeLabel="CSV" Progress="0.42" Status="Uploading" RemoveCommand="{Binding RemoveAttachmentCommand}" /> Use AttachmentStatus for uploading, completed, and failed visuals. Reaching progress 1 completes an uploading tile. IsRemovable controls whether the remove action is available. Relevant API ModelPicker InlineSuggestionBox VoiceWaveform AttachmentTile

docs/controls/prompt-bar.html.title: PromptBar | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/prompt-bar.html.summary: PromptBar PromptBar is a full-featured composer for AI applications. It supports ordinary prompt submission plus searchable commands and sources, structured model selection, reasoning effort, attachment requests, and dictation state. Basic use <nova:PromptBar Text="{Binding Draft}" CommandsSource="{Binding Commands}" SourcesSource="{Binding Sources}" ModelsSource="{Binding Models}" SelectedModel="{Binding SelectedModel}" SelectedEffort="{Binding SelectedEffort}" TurnId="{Binding TurnId}" Submitted="OnSubmitted" SourceSelected="OnSourceSelected" AttachRequested="OnAttachRequested" /> Typing / opens command suggestions. Typing @ opens sources. MaxSuggestionCount and SuggestionsMaxHeight keep large sources manageable. Collection changes are observed while the control is attached. Submission contracts Submitted captures the prompt text, selected model, selected effort, and TurnId before the draft is optionally cleared. For commands: Command receives the submitted text. SubmitCommand receives PromptSubmittedEventArgs. SourceSelectedCommand, ModelSelectedCommand, and EffortSelectedCommand receive their corresponding routed-event snapshots. AttachCommand replaces the built-in source-popup behavior when supplied. Set ClearOnSubmit="False" to keep the text. A handler can reject a submission before side effects by setting Cancel on the event arguments. Dictation Bind IsDictating to the host's recording state. AIKit supplies the visual state and start/stop labels; the application remains responsible for microphone permission, capture, and speech-to-text. Relevant API PromptBar PromptCommand PromptSource PromptSubmittedEventArgs ModelOption

docs/controls/recommendations.html.title: Recommendations | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/recommendations.html.summary: Recommendations RecommendationCard packages a proposed action with its rationale, confidence, alternatives, and stable orchestration metadata. ConfidenceMeter can also be used independently. <nova:RecommendationCard RecommendationId="restock-waffle-cones" TurnId="{Binding TurnId}" Revision="1" Title="Place this restock order?" Description="Reorder waffle cones from cone_king." Confidence="High" AlternativesSource="{Binding Alternatives}" AcceptCommand="{Binding AcceptRecommendationCommand}" AlternativeSelectedCommand="{Binding ChooseAlternativeCommand}" /> The stable recommendation ID, turn ID, and revision travel with acceptance events, allowing the host to reject stale UI actions safely. IsAccepted and IsAlternativesOpen make the card state bindable. Use RecommendationOption values for alternate actions. For a standalone semantic indicator: <nova:ConfidenceMeter Level="Medium" AccessibleName="Recommendation confidence" /> Customize the visible labels with NoneText, LowText, MediumText, and HighText. Relevant API RecommendationCard RecommendationOption ConfidenceMeter ConfidenceLevel

docs/controls/thinking-and-loading.html.title: Thinking and Loading | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/thinking-and-loading.html.summary: Thinking and Loading Use LoadingIndicator for a compact work state and ThinkingTrace when the host has meaningful steps, notes, searches, sources, or tool activity to disclose. LoadingIndicator <nova:LoadingIndicator Text="Churning" Variant="Drive" IsActive="{Binding IsRunning}" ShowElapsedTime="True" /> Choose from Drive, Dots, Orbit, Scan, Signal, and Spark. ElapsedFormat customizes the timer label, while IsAnimationEnabled can disable movement independently of IsActive. ThinkingTrace <nova:ThinkingTrace ItemsSource="{Binding Activity}" IsThinking="{Binding IsRunning}" IsExpanded="{Binding IsTraceExpanded}" SummaryText="{Binding ActivitySummary}" /> Populate the source with ThinkingStep, ThinkingNote, ThinkingQuery, ThinkingSource, and ThinkingToolCall items. While IsThinking is true, the header shimmers and elapsed activity is measured. Once complete, SummaryText can replace the active label. Use ItemsMaxHeight for long traces and bind IsExpanded two-way when expansion belongs in view-model state. Relevant API LoadingIndicator LoadingIndicatorVariant ThinkingTrace ThinkingStep

docs/controls/tool-calls.html.title: Tool Calls | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/controls/tool-calls.html.summary: Tool Calls ToolChip displays a single compact status. ToolCallList presents a structured, expandable collection of calls with arguments and output. <StackPanel Spacing="8"> <nova:ToolChip Text="Read 4 files" /> <nova:ToolCallList Header="Agent tools" ItemsSource="{Binding ToolCalls}" IsExpanded="True" /> </StackPanel> Model tool state Use ToolCall items with a ToolCallKind, ToolCallStatus, arguments, and optional ToolCallOutput. Output can represent text or a structured form through ToolOutputKind. Update the collection or item state as the orchestrator reports progress. ToolCallList summarizes one or many calls in its header, supports CallsMaxHeight, and can animate active or newly added work. Set IsAnimationEnabled="False" for static logs or screenshot tests. ToolChip.IsMonospaced is useful for filenames, commands, and code-oriented labels. Relevant API ToolChip ToolCallList ToolCall ToolCallOutput ToolCallStatus

docs/getting-started.html.title: Getting Started | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/getting-started.html.summary: Getting Started Follow these steps to install AIKit, register its resources, and add your first AI control. Prerequisites Avalonia 12.1.1 or later in the Avalonia 12 release line .NET 8 or later Install the package From your application project, run: dotnet add package Nova.Avalonia.AIKit Register NovaTheme Add the Nova XML namespace and place NovaTheme after your Avalonia base theme. The order matters because AIKit builds on the base theme's resources. <Application xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:nova="https://nova-ui.dev/aikit" x:Class="MyApp.App"> <Application.Styles> <FluentTheme /> <nova:NovaTheme /> </Application.Styles> </Application> NovaTheme includes the control themes, design tokens, icons, localized strings, light and dark colors, and the shared motion policy. It can also be placed after SimpleTheme. Add a prompt bar The same XML namespace exposes all controls: <UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:nova="https://nova-ui.dev/aikit"> <nova:PromptBar Text="{Binding Draft}" ModelName="Vanilla 1" PlaceholderText="Ask anything…" Submitted="OnPromptSubmitted" /> </UserControl> Handle the routed event when using code behind: private async void OnPromptSubmitted(object? sender, PromptSubmittedEventArgs e) { await _conversation.SendAsync(e.Message); } For MVVM, bind Command to receive the submitted text or SubmitCommand to receive the full PromptSubmittedEventArgs snapshot. Submission can be rejected by setting e.Cancel = true. Run the gallery The repository contains interactive samples for every major control: dotnet run --project samples/Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Gallery.Desktop The Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Hermes sample shows the controls composed into a complete AI workbench: dotnet run --project samples/Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Hermes Next, browse the control guides or read about theming and motion.

docs/introduction.html.title: Introduction | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/introduction.html.summary: Introduction Nova.Avalonia.AIKit is a UI toolkit for the interaction patterns around an AI system. It deliberately does not send model requests, store conversations, or require a specific provider SDK. Your application owns orchestration and state; AIKit renders that state and turns user actions into commands and routed events. What the kit provides Conversation controls for prompts, messages, streaming output, citations, and follow-ups. Agent controls for progress, reasoning activity, tool calls, task status, and delegation graphs. Human-in-the-loop controls for approval, recommendations, feedback, and fine-tuning. Code and data controls for diffs, file changes, retrieved context, records, filters, and insights. Shared tokens, accessible light and dark resources, localization strings, and motion policy through NovaTheme. How state flows Most controls accept ordinary values or IEnumerable sources. Bind your view model to those properties, then handle a routed event or command when the user acts. This makes the controls suitable for MVVM as well as code-behind samples. For example, a host can bind its transcript to ChatMessageList.ItemsSource, append chunks to StreamingTextBlock.StreamedText, and handle PromptBar.Submitted to start a model turn. AIKit remains independent of how the host obtains the response. Platform and theme support The package targets .NET 8 and Avalonia 12.1.1. Its themes layer on top of Avalonia Fluent or Simple, and the gallery demonstrates desktop, browser, Android, and iOS hosts. Motion-capable controls expose local animation switches and also respect the shared motion policy. How to use these docs Start with Getting started, then choose a workflow from the control guide. The Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls API reference contains every property, event, enum, and data item.

docs/theming.html.title: Theming and Motion | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
docs/theming.html.summary: Theming and Motion AIKit centralizes control styles, semantic colors, typography, icons, localized strings, and animation policy in NovaTheme. Choose a base theme Register either Avalonia Fluent or Simple before NovaTheme: <Application.Styles> <FluentTheme /> <nova:NovaTheme /> </Application.Styles> <Application.Styles> <SimpleTheme /> <nova:NovaTheme /> </Application.Styles> The resources use dynamic color lookups, so switching the application theme variant updates AIKit controls without rebuilding their visual trees. Override design tokens Place overrides after NovaTheme so they win resource resolution. Prefer semantic Nova keys over editing control templates. <Application.Styles> <FluentTheme /> <nova:NovaTheme /> <Style> <Style.Resources> <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NovaAccentBrush" Color="#7C3AED" /> <SolidColorBrush x:Key="NovaGreenBrush" Color="#059669" /> </Style.Resources> </Style> </Application.Styles> The theme exposes semantic resources such as NovaCanvasBrush, NovaSurfaceBrush, NovaFieldBrush, NovaLineBrush, NovaInkBrush, and status brushes. Use them for adjacent application UI to keep custom content visually consistent. Control motion Animation-aware controls expose IsAnimationEnabled. Disable it on a single control when animation would distract or interfere with deterministic testing: <nova:StreamingTextBlock StreamedText="{Binding Answer}" IsAnimationEnabled="False" /> NovaMotion provides the shared motion policy used by AIKit. Controls also account for visibility and detached visual trees so background animations do not keep doing unnecessary work. Localization and accessibility Visible labels and automation text are resource-backed or exposed as properties. Override strings after NovaTheme or bind the corresponding text properties for application-specific language. Keep meaningful labels on source, approval, and action controls, and use the API's AccessibleName properties where a visual alone would be ambiguous.

index.html.title: Welcome to Nova.Avalonia.AIKit | Nova.Avalonia.AIKit
index.html.summary: Welcome to Nova.Avalonia.AIKit Nova.Avalonia.AIKit is a provider-agnostic suite of controls for building AI-native applications with Avalonia. It provides production-oriented UI for chat, streaming responses, agent activity, human approval, tool calls, code review, retrieval, model selection, and usage dashboards. Start here Introduction explains the library's scope and design. Getting started installs the package, registers NovaTheme, and creates a first prompt experience. Theming and motion covers base themes, resource overrides, dark mode, and reduced motion. Control guides group the controls into practical AI workflows. The Nova.Avalonia.AIKit.Controls API reference lists the complete public surface. Control areas Area Included controls Conversation ChatMessageList, ChatComposer, StreamingTextBlock, FollowUpList, PromptBar Agent activity ThinkingTrace, LoadingIndicator, AgentAvatar, AgentTaskRow, AgentTimeline, MultiAgentGraph Human interaction ApprovalCard, FeedbackBar, RecommendationCard, SelectionToolbar, FineTuneCard Tools and code ToolChip, ToolCallList, CodeBlock, CodeDiffView, CodeFileTree Context and sources ContextCard, ContextUsageMeter, CitationChip, SourceChip, AttachmentTile Models and input ModelPicker, InlineSuggestionBox, VoiceWaveform Data and insights DiffTable, RecordsTable, FilterTable, SearchPanel, InsightCards, StatTile, ActivityHeatmap, SidebarNav Requirements Avalonia 12.1.1 or later in the Avalonia 12 release line .NET 8 or later The controls work with Fluent and Simple base themes and do not depend on a particular model provider or AI SDK.
